premises.text: Toil from complexity consumes half of developers' weeks and drives attrition costs
premises.evidence_span: Toil robs 25 million developers of the joy of coding

premises.text: Existing monitoring and security stacks bury developers in data outside the editor
premises.evidence_span: Developers toil in mountains of data, looking for information to fix performance issues, remediate security flaws, and rework broken code

premises.text: AppMap puts runtime behavior maps and analysis into the code editor developers already use
premises.evidence_span: AppMap is in the tool developers love the most, their code editor

premises.text: Runtime traces follow execution into data stores and across services for any environment state
premises.evidence_span: AppMap traces software execution wherever it goes, even into the data stores and across service boundaries

premises.text: Built-in analyses find performance and security issues such as N+1 queries and broken access control while coding
premises.evidence_span: no other tool can find them in the code editor

premises.text: Open-source integrations with languages/frameworks and IDE marketplaces with free individual tier drive adoption
premises.evidence_span: AppMap is open source to integrate with new languages and new communities

value.text: Developers reduce toil with personal observability that finds issues while they write code
value.evidence_span: software developers can see the behavior of their software as they write code

secondary_value.text: Shift-left dynamic security and performance analysis disrupt DAST/APM incumbents
secondary_value.evidence_span: the only tool to shift dynamic security analysis and performance analysis all the way left into the code editor

causal_links.evidence_span: if you are lost in toil, you need a map
personal observability, performance, and security analysis to developers when they work
from the VS Code and JetBrains marketplaces

notes: Free tier folded into open-source/marketplace domain. $40B opportunity framing not premise.
